objectives.text: Speak with Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village to learn to become a cook.

accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Speak with William Pickman in Brill to learn to become a cook.

complete.text:
Good goin', $c. This be exactly what I'm needin'.

Let's just keep this little transaction between us, ya? What Muln and the others don't know, won't be hurtin' nobody!

progress.text: How you doin' mon? Job done yet?

accept.text:
Ol' Mazu'kon got a bone to pick with a Witch Doctor that go by the name of Zum'rah and I be thinkin' you can help me out with that. 

Zum'rah practice all his bad voodoo in the Sandfury city of Zul'Farrak, far to the south in the deserts of Tanaris. Go there. Kill Zum'rah, and bring me his head.

Trust me mon, the world be a better place with his head stuck on pike outside my hut than it be sittin' on his shoulders.

objectives.text: Slay Witch Doctor Zum'rah and bring Zum'rah's Head to Mazu'kon in Mulgore.

accept.text:
I have had a vision.

Deep in the place known as Maraudon, past the earth song falls, there is a chamber filled with brilliant white crystals and guarded by mighty giants. At the highest part of this chamber is a crystal of exceptional brilliance. It is an aspect of the sun god, the right eye of the Earthmother herself--An'she.

I've dreamed of its radiance and it calls to me. $c, remove An'she's Radiance from that place and bring it here where it belongs, under the open skies of Mulgore.

objectives.text: Recover the crystal known as An'she's Radiance from Maraudon.

accept.text:
Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.

complete.text: Stay low and try not to be seen, $c. These cultists are not to be trifled with.

objectives.text: Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the Undercity.

accept.text:
Danitha and I fought against the Scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.

He might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the Light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.

If only the rest of the Forsaken felt the same way...

complete.text: I plan to stay here for a time and speak with more of my friends, but I will return to Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands soon enough. Should you ever find yourself out that way, please do say hello. We could always use more help from able-bodied adventurers.

objectives.text: Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.

accept.text: The Scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.

complete.text: Thank you for your aid, $c. If we do not wish to see Lordaeron's history repeat itself, we've got to be vigilant when threats like this spring up.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Dark Neophytes and $2oa Dark Enforcers in Tirisfal Glades.

accept.text:
It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.

During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal mounted atop Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the Scourge of them.

complete.text: Thank you. This should slow the efforts of the Scourge in this area. I suspect the denizens of Tirisfal will be pulling these crystals out of the ground for years, but removing the most conspicuous of them can only help.

objectives.text: Gather $1oa Necrotic Crystal Fragments in Tirisfal Glades.

progress.text: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.

accept.text:
You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.

If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.

complete.text:
This place is full of memories for me. This place was once held by the Argent Dawn. It was from here that we prepared for many battles and skirmishes against the Scourge during their most recent push into Tirisfal Glades.

When we withdrew to the Plaguelands I feared it would fall into disrepair. My fear was well-founded, but I am glad that Danitha and her paladins have taken over stewardship of it now.

She even named the keep after... a mutual friend.

objectives.text: Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.

accept.text:
Now that you have completed your training, it would seem the winds wish you to bond with your first strider.

These galestriders have been ridden by our ancestors for generations. Despite their wispy and slender appearance, they are steadfast and fierce mounts.

You and your strider will traverse the world together, so you have an important choice to make. Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go examine the striders and return to me when you have made your choice.

complete.text:
Excellent, $N. I can see in your eyes that you have made a choice.

I must say the one you have picked seems fond of you already, and it will be nice to have a reminder of home with you as your adventures take you far from Zephras. I hope you will take good care of it, and it of you.

Winds guide you both!

objectives.text: Inspect the riding striders to choose your first mount.

accept.text:
There is a servant of the Lich King that makes his home deep in the Death's Head quilboar lair known as Razorfen Downs. It is known to us that he makes use of a scrying orb to observe and direct the movements of his minions elsewhere.

With this artifact, we'd be able to hunt down the covert agents of the Scourge and put an end to them and the threat they pose to Kalimdor forever.

Go into Razorfen Downs to the lair of Amnennar the Coldbringer and retrieve the orb known as the Coldbringer's Eye for me.

complete.text: This will do nicely. We've deprived our enemies of an important tool, and equipped ourselves with a powerful weapon to use against the Scourge.

objectives.text: Recover The Coldbringer's Eye from Razorfen Downs.

progress.text: The Death's Head quilboar have been a constant thorn in our side for years, due in no small part to machinations of that accursed Lich.

accept.text:
Hello, $c! It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a galestrider, for a fee of course.

I will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each.

Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you about riding galestriders.

complete.text:
Marvelous! You have done a fantastic job. Learning how to ride one of these striders often takes patience and a steady hand.

They do not flee by nature, but who knows what things you and your mount will face out there in the greater world? Yes, it is best to be prepared!

objectives.text: Learn the Apprentice Riding skill from Genn Fairweather.

accept.text:
$n! Your arrival is timely, as always.

You have provided valuable assistance to the defense of Grom'gol, and we are grateful. After your recent push against the ogres nearby, we sent out a scout to see if there are more out there that may try to enact vengeance against us. As it turns out, there is a cave far to the east that they have claimed as their hovel.

Gather a friend or two and make it very clear that we will not tolerate another threat to our settlement, now or ever!

objectives.text: Commander Aggro'gosh of the Grom'gol base camp wants you to kill ogres at the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount.

accept.text:
A merchant caravan took a wrong turn through the desert and got jumped by the Dunemaul ogres. Only reason they made it out alive is 'cause they tossed some cargo overboard to distract the brutes.

Must be this merchant's got friends with the nobs runnin' ships and zeppelins, 'cause now they want ME pickin' up what got lost.

I'm stuck here working. But if YOU see a nice shiny bangle while you're beatin' on ogres, I'll make it worth ya while.

objectives.text: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris wants you to recover a particularly shiny bangle bracelet lost near the Dunemaul ogre compound.

progress.text: I can understand why some flashy metal might work to distract one of those oafs, everything they craft is mediogre.

accept.text:
Pssst, wanna know somethin'? It's easier to make profit in a place like this than you think... it's all about knowing how to market! I've seen what these tech-heads do when they get their hands on something they think they can turn into a fuel cell.

Even better if it's still glowin' or sputtering steam.

Why don't we strike a deal? Bring back some of the parts that fall off their machines in the desert, and I'll kick you back a share of the coin I get from selling the salvage back to the junkers!

objectives.text: Quinn wants you to recover $1oa  pieces of Desert Debris and return to her in Gadgetzan.

progress.text: Don't worry about any labels that say hazardous or toxic... I'll shred those up and they'll be none the wiser!

accept.text:
Oh, this fresh water smells so good... 

I'm going to stop for a moment and have a quick swim and a drink.

objectives.text: Show the newly quenched Tooga the way back to his wife, Torta.

accept.text:
One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?

Well, it doesn't.

Ours is a cursed life, $n. We must take from the living to further our own existence.

When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!

Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.

complete.text: Ah, excellent! Thank you for acquiring these. I can promise they will be put to good use.

objectives.text: Bring Shelene Rhobart $1oa Duskbat Wing Membranes, $2oa Darkhound Hides and $3oa Vile Fin Murloc Skin.

progress.text:
Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.

It may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.

Similarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... thick.

accept.text:
I noticed a few rocks that seemed unusual in the Dustbowl. Upon closer inspection, I saw that they had carvings! I could not resist making rubbings of them to study later.

The nearby ogres took notice of my presence and before I could even react, I woke up under the care of the innkeeper, and with a terrible headache.

Now, I am down all of my supplies and without any study material while I heal. Can you venture to the east in search of my pack, and take rubbings of the etchings yourself?

complete.text:
My supplies! And did you manage to--

<Mus'hale finds the scrawled parchment first thing upon opening the supply bag.>

Your aid is greatly appreciated, $N. With my belongings and some material to study, I've got more than enough to pass the time during my recovery. And I can afford to sleep inside the hut tonight.

Farewell, friend.

objectives.text: Slay ogres in the Dustbowl for Mus'hale's Stolen Supplies and use them to collect rubbings of the nearby stone etchings, then return to Mus'hale at Kargath.

progress.text: Have you any luck?

accept.text:
You look like a healthy, able-bodied skyborne. I am looking for someone to travel to Sunnyglade, in the Riverglades just north of the Redridge Mountains.

My family owned an armory there, once. Now I imagine it is a burnt husk, but I would have you retrieve a tome containing my family's ancestral armor crafting techniques. It was originally in the basement, so hopefully it has not succumbed to the elements just yet.

complete.text:
Thank you, $c. I very much doubt I would have survived the journey or destination, considering the state you say Sunnyglade is in now.

This tome is exactly what I needed. I am happy to say all of the pages are here as well.

Perhaps I can learn a new trade in undeath. It would give me a skill to hone for the rest of my unlife, at least.

objectives.text: Travel to Sunnyglade in the Riverglades and recover the tome of Tremayne Family Blacksmithing Techniques.

progress.text:
Ah, you have returned. Were you successful in recovering my family's tome? What state is Sunnyglade in?

The last time I laid eyes on my old town, it was being burnt to ash.

I joined the Stormwind army and traveled all the way up here to Lordaeron and died in the second war, so I never had a chance to return. I heard of efforts to rebuild Sunnyglade but I am not sure they ever were able to.

complete.text:

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

accept.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.

objectives.text: Speak with Indari Sunseam in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.

objectives.text: Speak with Mendalass Tattermend in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

accept.text:
The Witherbark know we be huntin' them like the traitors they are. Makin' plans and hideouts to keep their tribe in the shadows even after we burn 'em for their deceit.

Our scouts be findin' a cave west of Hiri'watha. One witch doctor, Ti'ik, he bring his voodoo inside--rot, decay, an' wrigglin' larvae for some foul magic.

We not lettin' that filth crawl through our homes while we sleep. Go, take his head, and crush whatever they be growin'. 

He be tough, so don't go underestimatin' him, ya?

complete.text:
Dis be the one. A wicked sight.

Spider eggs, maggots, none of dis be what we want in our village. 

Go on then with da loa's guidance. Revantusk be thanking you for the pest control.

objectives.text: Kill the Witherbark witch doctor known as Ti'ik in a cave west of Hiri'watha and return with his head.

accept.text:
I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.

Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!

objectives.text: Recover Nord'el for Sylessa Duskwhisper in Menethil Harbor.

accept.text:
You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.

I was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.

If you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.

complete.text:
I'm glad you made it back. That group of Al'Aketh looked like stone cold killers. 

Thank you for your aid, I'll include your assistance in my report when I return to Valanaar.

objectives.text: Kill 10 Al'Aketh Assassins in the Shen'dar Highlands.

accept.text:
Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.

You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.

<Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>

objectives.text: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Glix Xizzix in the Undercity.

complete.text:
What's this you've got...

Woah! Look at this marvel! The light through it dances like nothin' I've seen since my first dig in old Uldaman. The marks of the keepers on this cannot be mistaken.

You've done the League a great service bringin' this home. A find like this pushes the very boundaries o' the world's wisdom forward.

We'll be sure to record the details of your contribution! Truly a job well done, adventurer.

progress.text: Have a look at our gallery, but please, don't touch the artifacts, unless it's one you're here to donate to the library.

complete.text:
I should have known better than to think an abomination could write anything of use. Let us keep that lapse of judgment between us.

You have pleased me, and therefore pleased the Dark Lady. Perhaps there is hope for you.

progress.text: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.

accept.text:
If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.

Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Tomb Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.

accept.text:
Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all we stand for!

<Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>

Our ranks are thin. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.

complete.text:
Blessings upon you for aiding Dawnstone. Our order is still taking root here and it would be devastating to lose one so promising before his time.

Please accept this as a token of our thanks. Should you ever take an interest in our ways, our monastery Bandarion Keep lies on the bluffs northwest of the Solliden Farmstead. We welcome all who seek guidance in the Light.

objectives.text: Help Bareth Dawnstone escape Crusader's Outpost, and report his safety to Shari Stilwell in Brill.

progress.text:
The Windshapers presently find ourselves in need of silk cloth. If you could spare sixty pieces of silk then we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

A fine gift such as silk would certainly increase your honor and esteem amongst the Windshapers!

If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
